glosses: To appropriate; to lay claim to something, especially a discovery, which is perceived as belonging to someone else.

examples.text: When his black friend tells him that many people knew about the bar before he did, his white friend retorts by saying that he “Columbused it”; i.e., discovered it for white people before a gaggle of hip white people flooded in.
Of course, there is no bouncer, but we can be careful not to Columbus other culture's traditions.
He then lists other things that have been Columbused, such as twerking by Miley Cyrus and hummus by “health conscious whities.”
